attributes.title: Reveal
attributes.lede: An arrival happens once. An effect tracks the scroll.

lesson.concept: An arrival should reveal the meaning of a value
lesson.why: A row entering view brings its label, bar and numeric readout into attention. The bar uses a fixed domain, so a larger displayed value means the same thing in every row.
lesson.experiment: Scroll one row into view, then compare it with another. Try Curtain call and Flash reveal while checking that the final values remain readable.
lesson.pitfall: Normalizing each bar against a changing local maximum makes visually equal lengths mean different quantities.
lesson.combine: Combine with parallax when continuous depth and discrete data arrivals serve different purposes.
